newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Macquarie director Hall to retire.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Macquarie director Hall to retire.

text.p: Investment bank Macquarie Bank Ltd said on Wednesday one of its executive directors, Ray Hall, who is also head of the bank's treasury and commodities group, would retire in April after 15 years of service.

Macquarie managing director Alan Moss said Andrew Downe had been appointed the treasury and commodities group's new head from April 1997. Downe, also an executive director of the bank is currently joint head of the bullion and commodities division of the treasury and commodities group and is also the bank's country relationship manager for South Africa and Malaysia.

Macquarie listed its fully paid ordinary shares on the Australian Stock Excahnge (ASX) on July 29 after 15 years operation as Hill Samuel Australia Ltd and a further 11 years as the only substantial, Australian-owned investment bank.
